workload.note: Season ended in Week 3, 2025 due to a season-ending foot injury/surgery. Rushing: 32 car/95 yds/1 TD. Receiving: 9 tgt/8 rec/38 yds/1 TD (pro-football-reference).

scheme.note: MAJOR REGIME CHANGE: Cardinals fired HC Jonathan Gannon after 2025 (15-36 record) and hired Mike LaFleur as new HC. New OC Nathaniel Hackett replaces Drew Petzing, who left for Detroit. Separately, Kyler Murray was released March 11, 2026 - QB situation in flux, relevant context for the offense overall.
